item.title: mgk & Wiz Khalifa Announce ‘Blog Era Boyz’ Mixtape & Drop Star-Studded, Rebellious ‘Everything Tatted’ Video
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We've got some exciting news for fans of Mgk and Wiz Khalifa. The duo is back together after 13 years, and they're not just stopping at a single track. They've got a full joint project on the way, called the Blog Era Boyz mixtape, set to drop this Friday, May 22nd.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Mgk and Wiz Khalifa are currently touring North America together as part of Mgk's Lost Americana Tour, which kicked off on May 15th. They'll be making stops in cities like Austin, Dallas, Atlanta, and Vancouver, before wrapping up on July 1st.
[Short music transition]
Host: "The duo has already given us a taste of what's to come, with their new track 'Everything Tatted', released on May 20th. The song features a punk-inspired visual, with appearances by Bam Margera, Ty Dolla $ign, and skater Boo Johnson, among others.
[Short music clip from "Everything Tatted"]
Host: "The track is all about embracing individuality and self-expression, with Mgk and Wiz Khalifa showcasing their own unique styles. And with their joint project on the way, fans have a lot to look forward to. That's all for now. Check out the video for 'Everything Tatted' and get ready for the Blog Era Boyz mixtape, dropping this Friday."
[Outro music plays]
